Journal 2473 lines: 5400 DR 12228.60, 2000 CR 12228.60. The reversal swaps sides: 5400 CR 12228.60, 2000 DR 12228.60. The period must be open: PRD_ID 11 or 12. Journal 2473 is in PRD_ID 8, which is closed, so the reversal must go in an open period. I'll use PRD_ID 11 (the earliest open period, 20241101–20241130), which is the most conservative choice; the reversal date falls in that period.

The reversal lines balance (12228.60 DR = 12228.60 CR), and the status change voids only invoice 802.
